metadata.claim_boundary: Counterexamples target the reviewed formalization/checker scope; they do not establish paper novelty or empirical value.

results.scope: Exact one-node counterexample to Definition 8/Theorems 1--2 when X may contain Q.
results.summary: Strict descendants omit a changed certified root with no outgoing edge; a root-inclusive affected closure reopens it.
Only a valid, evidence-bearing, protected certificate for a downstream node preserved certification; changed roots and forged/stale certificates reopened.
Later success and an unauthorized discharge request did not erase a hard residual obligation; an authorized discharge did.

results.scope: Counterexample to the theorem's discriminating strength, not to the existential statement itself.
results.summary: Allowing T' to add a new goal state proves only that a larger model is more expressive; it does not isolate representation-only reframing.

results.scope: Strictness relative to stationary observation-based policies over the old quotient; no new sensing or latent state is added.
results.summary: With latent states, transitions, goals and retained information fixed, no old-quotient policy solved both starts while a legal observation refinement did.
Absence of a replacement proof does not logically create two target completions in every model class; the negative direction needs a richness premise or must be stated as a fail-closed rule.
Known complete coverage permitted task stop; local incompleteness yielded route stop; unknown/censored coverage yielded CANNOT_CHECK.

results.scope: Full five-by-five evidence/obligation matrix; this is stricter than typing only the authority-bearing judgment.
results.summary: Every one of the 20 foreign-domain evidence substitutions was denied and all five same-domain cases authorized.
A domain-only path exists even though adjacent coercions have incompatible scope maps; domain reachability alone would authorize an invalid composition.

results.scope: Finite AND/OR derivation graph; a simple descendant graph cannot express this distinction by itself.
results.summary: Revoking one evidence route preserved the certificate and its dependent through an independent derivation; revoking both routes removed both.
Missing evidence yielded CANNOT_CHECK; mismatched evidence, malformed obligation contracts and blockers yielded DENIED; a clean typed case authorized.
